description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer, Agents for Good based in the United States. 

 The Software Engineer will contribute to the development of innovative AI-powered products and intelligent agent frameworks designed to support organizations creating positive social impact. Working within a collaborative engineering team, you will build and enhance AI agents, develop scalable software solutions, and help shape the next generation of agent-based technologies. You will collaborate with senior and principal engineers to translate product requirements into reliable technical solutions while applying modern AI-native development practices. The role offers hands-on exposure to large language models (LLMs), agent orchestration, and emerging AI development tools. You will also contribute to improving engineering workflows, code quality, testing practices, and technical documentation. This is an exciting opportunity to grow your software engineering expertise while helping build responsible, purpose-driven technology.



Accountabilities:
 

 
 Develop, implement, and deliver features for AI-powered agents, including Development Agent, Data Health Agent, and other intelligent solutions.



 
 Contribute to the design, development, and continuous improvement of the shared agent framework used to build and deploy new AI agents.



 
 Design, build, test, and maintain scalable, reliable, and well-structured software across the technology stack.



 
 Apply AI-native software development practices and tools, such as Claude Code, to accelerate implementation and improve development quality.



 
 Contribute to the team's AI-native Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC), including the Plan, Code, and Verify stages, helping refine and improve engineering workflows.



 
 Collaborate with Senior and Principal Software Engineers to translate product requirements and business needs into effective technical designs and implementations.



 
 Develop and maintain automated tests to ensure software reliability, performance, and quality.



 
 Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and following established engineering standards and best practices.



 
 Troubleshoot, investigate, and resolve technical issues affecting existing AI agent features, applications, and services.



 
 Create and maintain technical documentation, development guidelines, and onboarding materials for the Agents for Good framework.



 
 Stay informed about emerging artificial intelligence technologies, large language model capabilities, and agent development techniques.



 
 Continuously apply new AI and software engineering approaches to improve product capabilities, development efficiency, and overall solution quality.




 Requirements:


 
 At least 2 years of professional software engineering or software development experience.



 
 Working knowledge of .NET Core, C#, and modern web development technologies.



 
 Experience with Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, and HTML.



 
 Familiarity with RESTful API development, application integration, and modern software architecture principles.



 
 Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.



 
 Exposure to developing or integrating large language model (LLM)-powered features is an advantage, particularly prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI agent orchestration.



 
 Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools, such as Claude Code, or a strong willingness to adopt AI-powered development practices.



 
 Understanding of software development best practices, including automated testing, code reviews, debugging, and maintainable code design.



 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to troubleshoot technical challenges and develop effective solutions.



 
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively alongside experienced engineers and cross-functional teams.



 
 A proactive, curious, and growth-oriented mindset, with enthusiasm for learning emerging technologies and continuously developing technical skills.



 
 Ability to work independently on clearly defined tasks while contributing positively to shared engineering objectives.




 Benefits:


 
 Competitive annual base salary: $87,700–$114,200 USD, depending on qualifications, experience, market conditions, and other business factors.



 
 Fully remote and flexible working environment within the United States.



 
 Medical, dental, and vision insurance.



 
 Wellness programs supporting employee health and wellbeing.



 
 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer matching contributions.



 
 Flexible paid time off.



 
 Generous paid parental leave.



 
 Pet insurance.



 
 Legal and identity protection services.



 
 Tuition reimbursement and continued learning opportunities.



 
 Donations for Doers program supporting charitable and community initiatives.



 
 Opportunity to work with innovative AI technologies, including intelligent agents and large language models.



 
 Collaborative engineering culture focused on responsible AI, innovation, continuous learning, and meaningful social impact.



 
 Opportunities to develop technical expertise and contribute to next-generation AI-powered products.
